role: Gate: replays the oracle's AnimalProbe dump (farm animals spawned the way SpawnerAnimals does, ticked the way World.updateEntities does) through animals.c, comparing every field of every entity after each tick, canonical NBT every 64th tick, removals, Det state and final blocks.
notes: Data: out/java/animals (an-2, an-42). Native calls: an_init, an_spawn_living, an_tick, living_nbt_hash/text, item_entity_nbt_hash/text, det_load. Which exact five animals the probe spawns was not checked in AnimalProbe.java; the list follows living.h's AK_ kinds. Reads getenv (a trace switch) in the test only. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
